name: playwright-practice-software-testing
description: UI, API and performance testing for the Practice Software Testing Toolshop demo (practicesoftwaretesting.com)

scripts.perf:normal: k6 run -e PROFILE=load -e PHASE=normal --summary-export perf/results/normal-summary.json perf/checkout-load.js
scripts.perf:ramp: k6 run -e PROFILE=load -e PHASE=ramp_up --summary-export perf/results/ramp-summary.json perf/checkout-load.js
scripts.perf:peak: k6 run -e PROFILE=load -e PHASE=peak --summary-export perf/results/peak-summary.json perf/checkout-load.js
scripts.perf:recovery: k6 run -e PROFILE=load -e PHASE=recovery --summary-export perf/results/recovery-summary.json perf/checkout-load.js

author: Kamal Hasan
